notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U} or {R}{R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating two Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
